events.recovery: Complete reply independently validated and reused; original rejection retained.

cost_notes: Embedding estimate includes prior probes at USD0.13/million input tokens, not a verified invoice. Generation price unknown. Missing usage is unknown, never inferred as zero.
memory_measurement: Not measured at user request; upstream zero memory fields are instrumentation placeholders.
provider_identity: Requested and reported model name; proxy internal backend mapping not independently verified.

request_timing.definition: Client dispatch-to-worker-exit; includes transport and response validation overhead, excludes cache hits.

preparation_timing: Earlier research, dependency installation, adapter development, review and approval were not precisely timed; excluded from active indexing. The diagnosed stop gap is separately recorded.
evidence_boundary: Interrupted index only. No retrieval or feature result; timeout is not evidence of retrieval quality.
